title: heze-devnet-2
announcements:
**Scope.** Next spec devnet on the **Heze** fork. Keeps [EIP-7805 FOCIL](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805) as shipped on [heze-devnet-1](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-1) and adds 2 new EIPs: EIP-8015 and EIP-8365 (CL only). EIP-8198 (Quick Slots) is **not** included; slots stay at 12s.
Consensus client images build from the common `heze-devnet-2` branch; execution clients reuse their heze-devnet-1 images, as there is no execution-layer change.
[bogota-devnet-0](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-0) (EIP-8141) is kept on a separate devnet track.
